author: Slidebean
description:
Why self directed AI learning changes the definition of intelligence.

Self directed AI systems represent a major shift in how intelligence evolves.
By generating their own questions and refining knowledge autonomously, models reduce dependence on human input while accelerating progress.

The implication isn’t just better performance, it’s the emergence of continuously evolving systems that redefine intelligence itself.

title: AI isn’t learning from us anymore, it’s learning on its own
